randomcape.config.title: Random Cape
randomcape.config.enabled.tooltip: Shuffles the cape randomly on every login.
randomcape.config.weighted.tooltip: When enabled, capes are drawn according to the weights you set.
randomcape.config.cape_weights.tooltip: Only takes effect when weighted draw is on
randomcape.shuffle_mode.tooltip.pseudo_r: Lists every cape you own and draws one each launch. Within a round, drawn capes are marked and skipped on the next launch, until every cape has been drawn — then a new round starts.
randomcape.weights.title: Cape weights
randomcape.weights.empty_hint: Could not read your capes. Log in with a premium account and make sure Mojang's servers are reachable
